articles.text: CLERK: Buongiorno, signor(in)a/signore, in che posso esserle utile?
CLERK: Good morning, ma'am/sir, how may I help you?
GUEST: Vorrei una camera doppia con bagno.
GUEST: I would like a double room with bath.
CLERK: Do you have a reservation?
GUEST: Purtroppo no. Mi può aiutare?
GUEST: Unfortunately, no. Can you help me?
CLERK: Mi dispiace, ho soltanto una singola con bagno. Le va bene?
CLERK: I'm sorry, I only have a single room with bath. Is that all right with you?
GUEST: Va bene. Rimango solo un giorno.
GUEST: That's OK. I'm only staying a day.
